evidence: GameObjectManager update loop calls GameObject.a(float) for every active GameObject; existing Projectile/CustomUnit semantics were update.
GameObjectManager render loop calls GameObject.c(float) as the main world draw pass; boolean return controls whether the object was drawn/handled.
Render loop calls f(float) before c(float) when zoomed-out/icon pass is active; Unit base implementation draws getZoomedOutIconImage().
Render loop invokes d(float) before main draw; CustomUnit implementation draws back image / underlay, so family name must be generic.
Render loop invokes e(float) for selected/highlighted/top-layer units; Unit implementation draws selection/highlight rings.
Render loop invokes a(float,boolean) after world draw with low/high zoom flag; Unit implementation draws hp/status/order overlays.
Render loop invokes p(float) after drawStatusOverlayLayer; CustomUnit uses it for render behavior overlay callbacks.
Visibility/camera predicate family; Projectile was previously mapped and GameObject base returns true.
